name: THOSE WERE THE DAYS
notes: Astoria, Queens setting, O'Connor and the 'Meathead' nickname for Mike Stivic all verified; category is the theme-song title, warm but not a leak.

name: BLINK & YOU'LL MISS HIM
notes: Cameos in roughly 39-40 of his films, including the Rear Window clock-winder and the Psycho cowboy hat; 'this portly English director' pins one answer.

name: PLAY IT BY EAR
notes: Born in Albany, Georgia, blind by 7, 1960 No. 1 that Georgia adopted as its state song in 1979 — all correct, and 'this piano man' rules out naming the tune.

name: THE GOLDEN DOOR
notes: 1892-1954 and some 12 million arrivals check out; flattest clue of the twelve — recall rather than riddle — but gentle and unambiguous.

name: RIVETING STUFF
notes: Was 41 — old wording read as if Jacob Davis were the San Francisco merchant, inviting the wrong response; rebuilt so Nevada tailor Davis brings the idea to Strauss, who funded their 1873 patent.

name: SUMMERS WITHOUT FEAR
notes: Murrow's April 1955 patent question and Salk's 'Could you patent the sun?' reply verified; brief widely reported quotation, no copyright issue.

name: MERMAID MIX-UP
notes: Columbus's January 1493 'mermaid' sighting off Hispaniola and Florida's winter spring gatherings both check out; plural clue against singular response is the only nit.

name: PIONEER GIRL
notes: Wisconsin Big Woods cabin, covered wagon and De Smet claim shanty are all genuine 'Little House' settings; category echoes her memoir title without leaking.

name: NEWSSTAND NOSTALGIA
notes: 321 Post covers, 1916-1963, and the Four Freedoms published in the Post in early 1943 — 'hundreds' and 'wartime' both fair.

name: TEE FOR TWO
notes: Latrobe birthplace, Arnie's Army and the tea-and-lemonade drink all correct; the drink is the perfect gentle 'of course' reveal.

name: V FOR VICTORY
notes: June 1940 'fight on the beaches' speech paraphrased, not quoted; cigar and premiership make the answer unmistakable.

name: THE LADY WHO NEVER WAS
notes: Washburn-Crosby of Minneapolis invented her in 1921 to sign replies to bakers' letters — verified; category flags the fiction without naming her.
